claims.assertion: Mari says no tangible barrier separates astral and material realms; perception and collective beliefs distinguish them.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She describes entities as using vibration differences to exploit people, seeking to lower individuals’ or regions’ frequency.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari offers several demon origins: attached narcissistic dead people, low-vibration creatures, or—under another theory—Nephilim souls or fallen angels.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says dark entities may organize hierarchically and feed on the fear and attention that sustain their egregor manifestations.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari says entities target high-vibration people through vulnerabilities, including unresolved trauma, to reduce their frequency.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
